content: [{"sha":"f74a45dfa4eac8872de49b5b7f9d3b4fa0eb1036","node_id":"C_kwDOADLKPNoAKGY3NGE0NWRmYTRlYWM4ODcyZGU0OWI1YjdmOWQzYjRmYTBlYjEwMzY","commit":{"author":{"name":"isaacs","email":"i@izs.me","date":"2026-10-30T21:08:02Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-10-30T21:08:02Z"},"message":"feat(astro): Add `@sentry/astro/integration` entry for the Astro integration (#25726) The root entry of `@sentry/astro` is both the server runtime SDK and, through its default export, the Astro integration for `astro.config`. The integration imports `@sentry/bundler-plugins/vite`, the orchestrion Vite plugin, `fs` and `createRequire`, so the server runtime entry reaches all of them. Any tool that traces or bundles the server entry then pulls that tooling in. The new `@sentry/astro/integration` entry exports the integration as its default and as `sentryAstro`. The root default export stays, deprecated, until the next major version, so existing `astro.config` files keep working. The E2E apps use the new entry. The new entry has a `node` condition that points at the ESM build, the same as `./middleware`. The CJS build of `@sentry/astro` does not load under the package's `"type": "module"`, and the existing entries avoid it the same way.
